product_summary: FOSS (Danish group, HQ Hillerød, Nils Foss Allé 1) is an analytical-instrumentation maker for agri-food quality control, not a metallurgy/mining supplier. Product lines confirmed on the corporate site (foss.dk / fossanalytics.com): NIR and FTIR analysers, flow-cytometry-based raw-milk analysers (MilkoScan/BactoScan-type), grain and flour analysers (falling number, fibre analysis, Kjeldahl digestion/distillation, solvent extraction), feed and forage analysers, meat analysers, wine/beer analysers, plus laboratory sample-preparation equipment, consumables, reagents and spare parts, and FOSS IQX digital/software services. Technologies listed by the company itself: Digestion, Distillation, Falling number, Fibre analysis, Flow Cytometry, FTIR, Hydrolysis, Image analysis, NIR, Sample preparation, Solvent extraction, X-ray image analysis.
comment: HS 8434.90 covers parts of milking machines and dairy machinery — FOSS makes no milking or dairy-processing machinery, so the declared code is a misclassification (wrong). Correct mapping: measuring/analysing instruments for physical/chemical properties → 9027.30 (spectrometers/spectrophotometers, incl. NIR/FTIR), 9027.89 (other instruments for physical/chemical analysis — flow cytometry, falling number, fibre), 9027.90 (parts and accessories of 9027 instruments), 8479.82 (mixing/agitating laboratory sample-preparation units, if applicable), 3822.19 (diagnostic/laboratory reagents, if reagents are traded). Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is a clear industry misclassification: the real sector is laboratory/analytical instrumentation for dairy, grain, feed, meat and beverage QC. Trader signs: FOSS India Pvt Ltd is the Indian sales/service arm of a foreign parent — the site presents a local-office network, service agreements, training and a webshop for consumables and spare parts, i.e. import-and-distribute plus after-sales service rather than own manufacturing in India; no Indian production facility is described. Product lines missing from the declaration: instruments and their parts/accessories (9027), software/digital services (no HS, service line), consumables and reagents (3822), and service/calibration revenue. Per project rules the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection — company is retained with corrected codes. All product statements above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked in this task (registry, revenue and customs volumes are out of scope here), so actual export/internal supply activity is not established. Note: the India-specific site foss.in did not respond (timeout) and search was unavailable, so the India entity's own catalogue could not be read directly; the product list is taken from the group's global site. PAN AABCF1735D and the Karnataka address were not verified in this task.
